title: Priority change priority-change.kp.declarative-choreography-constraint-layer-v1
summary: The accepted change-of-base review exposed a recurring class of errors: semantic role changes can preserve identity while typography follows a different schedule, and causal phase relationships remain unenforced local timing. Make a data-only declarative constraint compiler with typed conflicts, automatic metric interpolation obligations, native-settlement laws, registry-selected motifs, and an inspectable compilation trace the next architecture priority after the current visual checkpoint and release closeout.
